eyebrow.zh: 账号级风格锁定 · 尺寸合规 · 标题不越界

headline.zh:
锁一次账号风格，
之后每帖封面都合规、标题都在安全区
headline.en:
Lock the account look once —
every cover after is compliant, titles in the safe-zone

sub.zh: 把账号视觉冻结成一个可复用、可分享的风格资产；之后每张封面都从它生成，尺寸按平台规则强制合规，标题只排进安全区——超界自动缩字，绝不裁字。
sub.en: Freeze your account's look into a reusable, shareable style asset; every cover after is generated from it, size-enforced to platform rules, titles typeset only inside the safe-zone — shrunk, never cut, when they overflow.

title.en: Lock once, every post inherits it

body.zh: 别再每帖都从头重选风格——把账号视觉冻结成一个可复用、可分享的风格资产，之后每张封面都从它生成。同一个账号，跨帖跨天，同一套视觉。
body.en: Stop re-deciding your look for every post. Freeze the account's visual into a reusable, shareable style asset — every cover after is generated from it. One account, across posts and days, one consistent look.

title.zh: 尺寸永远合规，改规则只改配置
title.en: Sizes always compliant — rules live in config

body.zh: 出图后按平台规则把画面强制到 4:5 或 3:4，输出 100% 合规；平台改尺寸，只改规则表，不碰任何代码。
body.en: After rendering, each image is forced to 4:5 or 3:4 by platform rules — output is 100% compliant. Change a platform's size and you only edit the rules table, never the code.

title.zh: 标题永远在安全区，绝不裁字
title.en: Titles always in the safe-zone — never cut

body.zh: 标题只排进规则定义的安全区矩形，超界自动缩字号、换行，绝不裁字、绝不压到平台自己的浮层上。
body.en: Titles are typeset only inside the rules-defined safe-zone rectangle — when they overflow, the font shrinks and wraps, never cuts, never lands on the platform's own overlays.

title.zh: 零 key 离线，从安装到自证
title.en: Zero-key, offline — from install to self-proof

body.zh: 内置一个零 key、离线的本地模型，从安装到那张一致性 gallery 全链路无需任何 key、无需联网即可跑通；要出真图，带上你自己的图像模型 key 即可。
body.en: A zero-key, offline local model is built in — from install to the consistency gallery, the whole chain runs with no key and no network. Want real images? Bring your own image-model key.

headline.zh: 把账号视觉锁成一个资产
headline.en: Lock your account's look into an asset

sub.zh: 开源 · Apache-2.0 · 本地一条命令跑通。
sub.en: Open source · Apache-2.0 · runs locally in one command.

tag.zh: 给小红书封面做账号级风格锁定
